scenarios.name: normal_transfers
scenarios.description: Normal transfers across disjoint sender-receiver wallet pairs (minimal row-lock contention)

scenarios.name: hot_wallet
scenarios.description: Hot-wallet contention: multiple concurrent transfers originating from the exact same sender wallet
